{{Otheruses|Shape|more=Mandalorian (disambiguation)}}
{{Quote|The Jakelians, for one, welcomed their new Mandalorian overlords, as did knots of worlds populated by humans centered on Concord Dawn and Gargon. Those worlds—along with the likes of Hrthging, Breshig, Shogun, and Ordo—became part of Mandalorian Space.|"Industry, Honor, Savagery: Shaping the Mandalorian Soul"|<ref name="TEGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
"'''Industry, Honor, Savagery: Shaping the Mandalorian Soul'''" was the name of the speech [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Vilnau Teupt]] gave as the keynote speaker of the four-hundred-twelfth [[Proceedings of Galactic Anthropology and History]] at [[Brentaal Academy]]. Presented in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal]], Teupt attempted to concisely recount several [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] history and culture for the attending audience, from as far back as the founding of the [[Mandalorian Crusaders]] by the ancient [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] and the establishment of [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalorian space]], noting the [[Mandalorian religion|religious]] and [[New Mandalorians/Legends|cultural]] [[Supercommando Codex|changes]] that occurred throughout the Mandalorians' storied existence.<ref name="TEGW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vilnau Teupt's speech, "Industry, Honor, Savagery: Shaping the Mandalorian Soul," first appeared in ''[[Star Wars Legends]]'' [[canon]] in the reference book entitled ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''. [[Author/Legends|Authored]] by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]], and published on [[April 3]], [[2012]], an excerpt of the speech served as an in-universe medium for the reference book's section pertaining to Mandalorian history and culture.
